#### combinedEllipse (quasistationary)

The ellipse geometry of `quasistationary/dirichletEllipse` with both boundary
treatments at once: the outer contour is a traction boundary
(`StationaryLinearElasticityMRTNeumannValidation`) while the two inner contours
are displacement boundaries
(`StationaryLinearElasticityMRTDirichletValidation`). This is the most general
of the quasistationary cases and validates that the two schemes can be mixed on
curved boundaries within one simulation.

The `run.sh` script performs the same resolution sweep and order of convergence
study as `quasistationary/periodicPlate`.
